product.name: Deasy Labs Metadata Workflow Platform
product.description: A platform that automates tagging, filtering, and enriching unstructured data to create structured metadata at scale.

product.name: Automated Schema and Taxonomy Extraction
product.description: Technology that automatically derives domain-specific metadata schemas and taxonomies from unstructured data without expert input.

product.name: Human-in-the-Loop Metadata Validation Studio
product.description: A tool that allows users to test, validate, and fine-tune metadata tags through interactive human review.

product.name: Metadata Export and Integration Services
product.description: Services that export and synchronize metadata with cloud storage systems and vector databases for downstream consumption.
